title: Castelion split story
description: A full-bleed painted backdrop band with a page-colour text panel standing over its middle third (over its middle on phones, with backdrop strips above and below), holding two stories: a big bold navy title and a justified paragraph each. Two tall, narrow cut-out slots float over the backdrop's left side. While you scroll the backdrop drifts up slowly and the two cut-outs climb much faster, a layered parallax; titles slide out of masks.
notes: slots: backdrop (cover, full-bleed) and objects (two transparent cut-outs, e.g. vehicles; empty they are translucent page-colour panels)
scroll-driven CSS parallax; static and reduced-motion views show the layers in place
